source_locator: PDF p. 57, Turkey / TOGED panel: 2023 employment bar 10,777; questionnaire PDF p. 76, question 2 and definitions
definition: TOGED's submission to EGDF for people working for game-developer studios and third-party publishers registered in Turkey. EGDF defines the requested measure as FTE employees, entrepreneurs and in-house freelancers. It includes remote employees in third countries where the Turkish-registered studio employs them; it excludes employees of foreign subsidiaries and foreign subcontractor companies. EGDF excludes service providers that are not a game developer studio or publisher. Turkey-specific collection, gross-up and FTE implementation are not published. This reconfirms the baseline observation, rather than establishing a new point.
